# `kernel/arch/hp300/dev` — architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel (device drivers)

<!-- generated by tools/gen_folder_readmes.py -->

## English

This directory contains architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel (device drivers).

`config.mk` records 28 source file(s) here: `ac.c`, `cons_conf.c`, `ct.c`, `dcm.c`, `dma.c`, `fhpib.c`, `grf_conf.c`, `grf_dv.c`, `grf_gb.c`, `grf_hy.c`, `grf_machdep.c`, `grf_rb.c`, ....

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.

## 中文

本目录包含4.5BSD 内核的机器相关代码（设备驱动）。

`config.mk` 记录了 28 个源文件：`ac.c`、`cons_conf.c`、`ct.c`、`dcm.c`、`dma.c`、`fhpib.c`、`grf_conf.c`、`grf_dv.c`、`grf_gb.c`、`grf_hy.c`、`grf_machdep.c`、`grf_rb.c` 等。

这些 `config.mk` 清单来自 4.5BSD 源码树，是参考元数据；BSD45 的构建脚本（`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`）会显式选择实际参与编译的文件。
